content: Demonio löcuyätsishgan runata Jesucristo aliyätsishgan
Lagünata tsimparcurna chayapäcorgan Gadara nishgan partiman.
Büquipita Jesús urarcuptinmi demoniucuna löcuyätsishgan runa panteonpita yargamorgan.
Tsay runaga panteonchömi täcog. Atsca cuti runacuna cadënawan chaquinpita maquinpita watashgantapis rachirmi ushareg. Tsaynog captinmi pipis ima ruraytapis mana camäpacorgantsu.
Tsaymi gaparaycar chunyag jircapa y panteonpa pagasta junagta puricog. Tsaynogpis rumicunawan tacacuraycarmi maypapis pureg.
Tsauraga Jesusta ricarmi cörrila aywaycur paypa naupanman tsay runa gongurpacuycorgan.

Payta ricaycurmi Jesús caynog nergan: “¡Demonio, yarguy cay runapita!” Tsaynog niptinmi tsay runacho cag demoniucuna fiyupa gaparashpan caynog nergan: “¡Munayniyog Diospa tsurin Jesús! ¡Cay runapita ama gargaycalämaytsu!”
Tsauraga tsay demoniucunata Jesús taporgan caynog nir: “¿Imatag jutiqui?” Tsaynog tapuptin demoniucuna caynog nergan: “Nogapa jutëga Legionmi.
Tsay jutëga caycan tsaytsica captëmi.”
Tsaynog nircur demoniucuna Jesusta ruwacärergan tsaypita caruman mana gargunanpag.
Paycuna caycashgan washa lädunchömi ishcay waranganog (2,000) cuchicuna micurcaycargan.
Tsauraga tsay demoniucuna Jesusta manacärergan cuchicunaman yaycapäcunanpag.

Tsaynog manacäriptinmi cuchicunaman yaycunanpag aunergan. Tsauraga demoniucuna runapita yargurir yaycapäcorgan tsay cuchicunaman. Tsaymi cuchicunaga löcutashpan tunapa cörrir lagünaman jegacurporgan. Tsaychömi shengaypa wanupäcorgan.

Tsayta ricaycurmi cuchi mitsegcunaga mantsacashga cörrila aywargan marcacho tag runacunata y cercancho tag runacunatapis wilananpag. Wilapäcuptinmi runacuna aywapäcorgan ima pasashgantapis ricananpag.

Tsayman chayapäcushpanmi tsay löcu runata taripäcorgan Jesuspa naupancho aliyashgana caycagta. Ali yarpayninchöna cashpanmi röpashgana jamaraycargan. Tsayta ricaycurmi runacuna mantsacashga ricacorgan.
Cuchi mitsegcunami shamog runacunata wilargan demoniucuna löcuyätsishganpita imanogpa tsay runa aliyashganta y cuchicuna shengaypa wanushgantapis.
Tsayta mayaycurmi pasaypa mantsacashga lapanpis Jesusta nipäcorgan tsaypita aywacunanpag.
Cuticunanpag büquiman Jesús witsarcuptinmi tsay aliyag runa Jesusta manacorgan paywan aywacunanpag.
Tsaynog manacuptinmi Jesús caynog nergan: “Nogawan aywanayquipa trucanga wayiquipa cuticuy. Tsaychöna castayquicunata wilapanqui Tayta Diosnintsi cuyapäshushpayqui aliyätsishushgayquita.”
Tsaynog niptinmi tsay runa jinan Decápolis provinciacho mayman chayarpis wilapargan Jesús aliyätsishganta. Tsaynog wilacuptinmi lapan mayagcuna cushicärergan.
Jairupa tsurinta cawaritsimushgan y yawar apaywan gueshyaycag warmita Jesucristo aliyätsishgan
Tsaypita Jesús büquiwan lagüna wac tsimpanman chayananpäga tsaytsica runacuna juntacashga payta shuyarpaycargan.
Tsaymanmi chayargan sinagogacho mandag Jairo jutiyog runa. Paymi Jesuspa naupanman gongurpacuycushpan caynog nergan:
“Warmi tsurë wanuycannami. Aywayculäshun aliyätsinayquipag, tayta.”
Tsaynog ruwacuptin Jesús aywargan Jairuwan. Paywan aywaptinmi atsca runacuna Jesusta gatirpargan quichquiypa quichquirrag.
Tsay runacunawanmi aywaycargan chunca ishcay (12) watana yawar apaywan gueshyaycag warmipis.
Tsay gueshyawan fiyupa nacarmi imaycancunatapis ranticur ushargan mëdicucunata pägananpag. Imanogpa jampicurpis manashi aliyargantsu. Aliyänanpa trucanga masshi antsargan.
Jesús aliyätsinanpag munayniyog cashganta musyarmi tsay warmega guepalanpa yaycuycur paypa röpanta yataycorgan.
Tsaynog rurargan: “Jesuspa röpanta yataycularpis aliyäshagmi” nishpan.
Yataycuptinmi jinan höra yawar apaynin chawarganna. Tsaymi tantyargan aliyashgana caycashganta.
Tsauraga röpanta yataycur pipis aliyashganta musyarmi Jesús caynog nergan: “¿Pitag röpäta yataycamashga?”
Tsauraga discïpuluncuna nipäcorgan: “Tayta, caynog quichqui aywaycaptintsega ¿imanogparag musyashwan maygan yatashushgayquitapis?”
Tsaynog nipäcuptinpis Jesús ricchacuycargan pï yataycushgantapis musyananpag.
Tsauraga tsay warmi mantsacushpan sicsicyaycar Jesuspa naupanman gongurpacuycorgan. Nircurmi wilargan paypa röpanta yataycur aliyashgantapis.
Tsaynog wilaptinmi Jesús caynog nergan: “Nogaman yäracamashgayquipitami aliyashgana caycanqui. Cananga cushishgana cuticuy.”
Jesús tsaynog parlaycaptinragmi Jairupa wayinpita wilacog chayaycur Jairuta caynog nergan: “Tsuriqui wanushganami caycan. Amana Jesusta pushaynatsu, tayta.”
Tsaynog niptinmi Jairuta Jesús caynog nergan: “Ama laquicuytsu. Nogaman yäracamaptiquega tsuriqui cawarimongami.”
Tsaynog nircushpanmi Jairupa wayinman Jesús aywargan Pedruta, Santiaguta y Juanta pushacurcur. Waquincuna aywanantaga manami munargantsu.
Jairupa wayinman chayaycurmi Jesús tarergan runacuna tsaycho pasaypa laquicushpan wagarcaycagta. Tsaymi Jesús caynog nergan:
“¿Imanirtag tsayjinanpa wagarcaycanqui? Jairupa tsurenga manami wanushgatsu caycan, sinöga punuycanlami.”

Tsaynog niptinmi wanushga caycashganta musyashpan tsaycho caycag runacuna Jesús nishganta mana criyergantsu. Tsaynog captinpis lapan runacunata tsay wayipita wagtaman yargunanpag nergan. Nircurmi Jairuta, warminta y discïpuluncunata pushacurcur Jairupa tsurin tsutaraycashgan cagman yaycorgan.
Yaycurir wamrata maquinpita aptarcur caynog nergan: “Talita, cumi.” (“Talita, cumi” nishganga “Jipash, sharcuyna” ninanmi.)

Tsaynog niptinmi Jairupa tsurin jinan höra cawarircamur sharcurcur purergan. (Payga cargan chunca ishcay (12) watayognami.) Jipashita cawarimushganta ricaycurmi lapan tsaycho cagcuna pasaypa cushicärergan.
Nircurmi mamanta y taytanta Jesús nergan aliyätsishganta pitapis mana wilapänanpag. Nircurnami jipashitata garananpag nergan.
